name: Sliding leg curl

phases.name: curl
phases.cue: Pull your heels in towards your glutes

phases.name: reset
phases.cue: Keep your hips off the floor

formTips: Lie on your back with your heels on sliders (or towels on a smooth floor)
Lift your hips into a bridge so your body is straight from shoulders to heels
Keeping your hips up, pull your heels in towards your glutes
Slide your legs back out slowly without letting your hips touch the floor
commonMistakes: Letting the hips drop as the legs slide out
Arching the lower back instead of squeezing the glutes
Pushing through the arms instead of the legs
